title: Visual Concept Steering Side-Effects in CLIP via Prisma SAEs

original_idea.body:
# Visual Concept Steering Side-Effects in CLIP via Prisma SAEs

**Problem:** Steering side-effects are documented for language but the vision-transformer analogue is unexplored.

**Direction:** Using ViT-Prisma vision SAEs, steer a clean feature and measure intended effect plus collateral changes on unrelated concepts; map the vision-side side-effect profile.

**Why it matters:** Knowing whether interpretable interventions are surgical on the vision side matters as multimodal models deploy.

**Relevant context:** Joseph et al. (arXiv 2504.19475); Rogue Scalpel.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Vague impact: vision-steering side-effects matter for control but lack a specific catastrophic scenario or explicit chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses pre-trained Prisma SAEs + steering tooling, no training; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused steering-side-effect mapping on one feature; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public Prisma weights, multimodal interp lags; lab-independent.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on vision SAEs; single mid GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Vision-side steering side-effects appear largely unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Vision-transformer steering side-effects appear largely unexplored.
